correctness.rationale: The source current identity and stationary Fokker--Planck equations imply the precisely signed weak-v resolvent formula. The reversible generator K=-T∂²+U′∂, with Kx=-f, has Dirichlet energy <x,Kx>=T and <Kx,Kx>=b². Spectral calculus gives a positive Stieltjes measure, hence strict increasing/concave rate response and both dominated-convergence tails. Direct equilibrium integrals give V=2T²/b²+2a²/(2-exp(-ab/T)); derivative at fixed b is positive for a>0. Two tails identify b then a; analyticity extends interval equality. A 116-assertion finite-grid checker reproduces identities and quadratures but is explicitly not an infinite proof. Cusp transmission and weak-drift differentiability are handled by stationary elliptic perturbation with gap, normalized jointly with orientation.
